# Nervos Network

> Nervos Network is a blockchain network whose Layer 1, Common Knowledge Base (CKB), is secured by Proof-of-Work. CKB uses the Cell Model, an extension of Bitcoin's UTXO model, and a RISC-V-based virtual machine (CKB-VM).

## Start here

- [Nervos CKB](https://www.nervos.org/ckbpage): An introduction to CKB, its native token, and the Nervos DAO.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.nervos.org/knowledge-base): Educational articles covering blockchain fundamentals and Nervos CKB.
- [CKB introduction](https://www.nervos.org/knowledge-base/start-here): A guided introduction to CKB's architecture and applications.
- [All articles](https://www.nervos.org/knowledge-base/articles): Browse the published Knowledge Base articles.

## Key concepts

- [Nervos architecture](https://www.nervos.org/knowledge-base/nervos_overview_of_a_layered_blockchain): CKB's layered architecture, Cell Model, consensus, and virtual machine.
- [UTXO model](https://www.nervos.org/knowledge-base/utxo_model_explained): Unspent transaction outputs and the UTXO accounting model.
- [CKB tokenomics](https://www.nervos.org/knowledge-base/tokenomics_of_nervos_network): Token issuance, state rent, miner incentives, and the Nervos DAO.
- [Blockchain virtual machines](https://www.nervos.org/knowledge-base/comparing_blockchain_virtual_machines): A comparison of blockchain virtual machines, including CKB-VM.
